verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site describes it as a self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. The public go-gitea/gitea GitHub repository includes build and development docs, so the source is readable and buildable. A community user's critique of specific internals (go-macaron, Go templates) shows outsiders do read the codebase. Missing for 10: a citation of the repository's LICENSE file itself (the MIT claim comes only from the marketing page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license.
See docs/build-setup.md for prerequisites and docs/development.md for setting up a local development environment, linting, and testing.
'Gitea isn't a great Go codebase,' though much was inherited from Gogs.
